title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards AutoPay Terms
content:
**Enrollment and changes.** A Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards cardmember can enroll in AutoPay with one of the card's AutoPay amounts, change the amount option or the fixed amount, or cancel AutoPay by setting the option to none.

**When a change applies.** A change made at least the card's AutoPay change lead time in business days before a payment due date applies to that due date; a later change applies from the following due date, and the instruction already scheduled for the nearer due date runs unchanged.

**What is drafted.** AutoPay pays on the payment due date the minimum payment due, the statement balance, or the fixed amount. When the fixed amount is below the minimum payment due, the minimum payment due is paid instead, and when the statement balance or minimum due is 0.00 nothing is drafted. Amounts under open billing dispute are excluded from the AutoPay draft.

**Account condition.** The account is not in declined or charged-off status, as the company's account record shows; an active, restricted or closed account can carry an AutoPay change. AutoPay stays in force after an account is closed until the balance is paid in full.

## Lead time illustrated (hypothetical due date Friday the 20th; lead time 3 business days; no holidays)

| Change made on | Business days before the due date | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| Monday the 9th | well over 3 | the due date of the 20th |
| Thursday the 19th | fewer than 3 | the following due date; the draft already scheduled for the 20th runs unchanged |

## Draft amounts (hypothetical statement)

| Option | Statement balance | Minimum payment due | Fixed amount | Drafted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| fixed amount | USD 900.00 | USD 45.00 | USD 100.00 | USD 100.00 |
| fixed amount | USD 900.00 | USD 45.00 | USD 30.00 | USD 45.00 |
| statement balance | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | — | nothing |
| minimum payment due | USD 900.00, of which USD 200.00 under open billing dispute | USD 45.00 | — | the draft leaves out the USD 200.00 under dispute |
